2026 Sponsorship Opportunities

There are now more ways to partner with the region's largest rowing regatta in 2026: #HOTOtv, our new live broadcast of race day on Instagram, and Updated Traditional Sponsorship Tiers that include weekend-of signage, newsletter ads, long-term website presence, and more. The Sponsorship Opportunities below are available for 2026, and this year's Sponsors hold "first dips" on that same slot the following year.

2 · Bay Sponsors Four slots · $10,000+ each

A Bay Sponsor plays two roles at once. During HOTO weekend, a custom-sized Banner hangs above that team's bay — seen by every athlete on the dock and much of the crowd. For the rest of the year, they stand as a programmatic sponsor of that team's rowing program.

That programmatic support is credited well beyond race day: in the Race Packet and other published materials, on the HOTO website, and in the Boathouse Blog.

25% of each Bay Sponsorship goes to that bay's university or program — 50% if they secure the sponsor themselves. Correctly sized banners are produced by TRRA and included in the price.

3 · Flood Wall Sponsor

A dedicated 5' × 15' banner spot on our massive retaining wall aside the Rosen Adaptive Bay for the weekend. Sponsorship supports Three Rivers Youth Rowing (TRYR) and the __Sponsor Name__ Safety Enhancement Initiative (SEI).

This is a Premier Sponsorship position presented in partnership with the TRRA Development Committee. __This Sponsor__ works closely with TRRA and other organizations to promote on-water and off-water safety enhancements.

__The Sponsor__ for this position generously donates $25,000 annually to the SEI and TRYR programs in the form of needed equipment and high-level coaching certifications.

New benefits for 2026

Logo on the new HOTO Map

Detailed HOTO Map to be printed and distributed across the venue and at race-day registration and packet pick-up.

Maps will include graphics, important sites, and a list of Sponsors.

The Boathouse Blog

One shared post for all sponsors — real information about each company — sent to the full HOTO newsletter of +2,600 contacts.

Permanent published place on www.threeriversrowing.org/crew-articles.

HOTO Coupon Book Space

Availability in the 2026 HOTO Coupon Book.

A new tradition in 2026. Partner organizations and sponsors have the opportunity to advertise and offer exclusive HOTO coupons and offers not made anywhere else.

Logo on Volunteer Shirts

Back-of-shirt placement, seen all weekend as Volunteers travel the length of the race course — from Millvale to the North Shore.

Volunteer Shirts are bright green high-visibility and are sure to be noticed by all who pass.

The Boathouse Blog Where the story gets told

HOTO 2025 Recap + Photos →

TRRA launched The Boathouse Blog the week after the 38th Head of the Ohio. The 2025 recap covered 62 crews, 551 boats, 90 events, 1,500+ competitors, 50+ volunteers, and 5,000+ spectators.

  • Who: rowers, paddlers, dragon boaters, volunteers, visitors.
  • What: regatta recaps, photos, stories, rowing tips, sponsorships.
  • When: in alignment with the greater global and organizational calendar.
  • Where: the TRRA website.
  • Why: amplify the amazing stories unfolding at boathouses across the country every day.
